description: Context-sensitive historical/OCR forms. Observed text is never overwritten.

forms.notes: Treat as a title marker when attached to a following name; preserve the exact OCR form.
In this corpus, usually refers to the council/committee group rather than an individual.
Treat as a possible surname/proper noun, especially after an Mr-title form; do not use as a hard negative.
Usually likely to refer to numbers in the List of Records when preceded by that phrase; retain as uncertain outside that context.
The role/title is not an identity. Use PERSON_REF only when the surrounding sentence clearly refers to the role-holder as a person.
